svg.aria-label: Security design. Trust levels, least to most trusted. Level 1, Internet: Nothing outside can start a connection into the lab. Level 2, Edge and firewall: The router and firewall filter and inspect traffic. Level 3, Inside network: Six networks, kept apart by rules on the core switch. Level 4, Management: Only the admin PC can log in to the switches and router. Who can reach what. Management, VLAN 10 (Admin PC, switches, access points, Proxmox host): can reach Internet, Internal, Servers, Storage · admin PC, Proxmox, Cameras · admin PC; blocked from Guests; rule: Admin-SSH: only the admin PC can log in to devices. Servers, VLAN 40 (Domain controllers, file server, monitoring): can reach Internet, Internal, Storage; blocked from Cameras, Guests, Switch logins; rule: None: trusted, routed freely by the core. Internal, VLAN 20 (Family PCs and phones, Internal Wi-Fi): can reach Internet, Servers; blocked from Storage, Cameras, Guests, Switch logins; rule: None: kept out by the NAS, camera and guest rules. Storage, VLAN 60 (UniFi UNAS Pro): can reach Servers, Proxmox, Admin PC, Internet · updates; blocked from Internal, Cameras, Guests; rule: NAS access list on the core switch. Cameras, VLAN 50 (Four PoE cameras and the NVR): can reach Admin PC only; blocked from Internet, Internal, Servers, Storage, Guests; rule: IP-Cameras access list on the core switch. Guests, VLAN 30 (Visitor Wi-Fi): can reach Internet; blocked from Internal, Servers, Storage, Cameras, Management; rule: Guest-Internet access list on the core switch.
svg.title: Security design
